name: Acumatica
description_en:
Acumatica is a cloud ERP platform with connected financial, order, inventory and industry applications. Choosing it means selecting an application scope, resource capacity and deployment arrangement, rather than merely counting login seats.

This profile examines an order-to-fulfillment path and the operating consequences of the SaaS offering. Industry editions, optional planning functions and marketplace integrations require their own scope. No installation, order, integration or restore was executed.
description_zh:
Acumatica 是云 ERP 平台，连接财务、订单、库存及行业应用。选型需要确定应用范围、资源容量及部署安排，不能只数登录席位。

本文沿订单到履约流程研究，并核对 SaaS 的运营条件。行业版本、可选规划功能和市场集成需各自明确范围；未执行安装、订单、集成或恢复。

core_features.explanation_en: Sales orders can be linked to purchase orders and received stock allocated to the originating demand.
core_features.explanation_zh: 销售订单可关联采购订单，并将收货库存分配给原需求。

core_features.explanation_en: The inventory application describes quantities, allocations, availability, transfers and costs across warehouses.
core_features.explanation_zh: 库存应用介绍多仓库的数量、分配、可用量、调拨及成本。

core_features.explanation_en: Requests can be grouped into requisitions, routed for approval and compared with supplier bids.
core_features.explanation_zh: 可将请求汇成请购单，审批后比较供应商报价。

pricing.billing_basis: Applications, usage/resources and deployment, not seats. APEX Distribution has a separately advertised starting package.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Custom scope; named APEX Distribution offer starts USD $1,495/month on the product page, not a universal ERP price.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 按范围报价；产品页的 APEX Distribution 具体组合起价每月 1,495 美元，不能当成通用 ERP 价格。

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from the attached primary sources. Vendor documentation does not establish independent testing or customer outcomes.
Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.title_en: Follow demand through supply and fulfillment
sections.title_zh: 沿需求跟踪供货与履约
sections.en:
The order-management page connects pricing, approved quotes, sales orders, purchase orders, receipts and fulfillment. Received items may be allocated to the sales order that generated demand. Stock and non-stock orders have different handling, so a service sale should not be evaluated as though it requires a warehouse movement.

For a hypothetical distributor, take a ten-unit customer order with six available units. Inspect availability, purchasing for the shortage, receipt allocation, partial fulfillment and the resulting financial records. These are acceptance questions, not a tested configuration or a promise that any delivery date can be met. Connected commerce or EDI orders still require an appropriate connector and mapping.
sections.zh:
订单管理页把价格、已批准报价、销售订单、采购订单、收货及履约相连；收到的物品可分配到产生需求的销售订单。库存与非库存订单的处理不同，不能把服务销售也当成必须发生仓库移动的场景。

以假设的分销商为例，客户订十件、现有六件，可检查可用量、缺货采购、收货分配、部分履约和财务记录。这些是验收问题，并非已测试配置，也不保证任意交期都能满足。电商或 EDI 订单仍需适用连接器和映射。

sections.title_en: Quantity, availability and valuation answer different questions
sections.title_zh: 数量、可用量和估值回答不同问题
sections.en:
The inventory page describes item attributes/matrix items, units of measure, kits/disassembly, location-level quantities and stock allocations. Planning includes lead times, seasonality, safety stock and reorder policies, with DRP described as an additional planning capability. Costing methods listed include standard, average, FIFO and specific cost.

Before migration, agree item identifiers, unit conversions, warehouse locations and valuation policy. Test a transfer and a return as well as a sale. A quantity may exist but already be allocated; a stock count and inventory value are not interchangeable totals. Optional planning and specialized warehouse integrations should be specified in the selected edition rather than presumed present everywhere.
sections.zh:
库存页介绍物品属性与矩阵物品、计量单位、套件拆解、地点数量及库存分配。规划涉及交期、季节性、安全库存和补货规则，DRP 属于另行描述的规划能力。列出的计价方式包括标准成本、平均成本、先进先出及个别成本。

迁移前商定物品标识、单位换算、仓库地点和计价政策，并在销售之外测试调拨及退货。有数量可能已被分配，库存数量与价值也不是可互换的总额。可选规划及专用仓储集成需写入所选版本，不能推定所有环境都有。

sections.title_en: Unlimited users still require resource and application pricing
sections.title_zh: 不限用户仍要按应用和资源报价
sections.en:
The official pricing page read on 22 October 2026 identifies three cost factors: implemented applications, expected usage/resources and deployment/license choice. It states that user seats are not the charging basis. Unlimited users therefore does not mean unlimited transactions, storage, application scope or implementation service.

The order and inventory pages separately advertise APEX for Distribution starting at USD $1,495 monthly with support and implementation in the described package. That is a named package’s starting offer, not a universal Acumatica quote. Ask for the exact applications, capacity, integrations, implementation and deployment terms; this profile did not obtain a quote and leaves normalized monthly price unknown.
sections.zh:
2026 年 10 月 22 日读取的官方定价页列出三类成本因素：实施的应用、预计用量资源，以及部署许可选择，并说明不以用户席位计费。因此不限用户不等于交易、存储、应用范围和实施服务均无限。

订单和库存页另外宣传 APEX for Distribution，起价每月 1,495 美元，所述组合包含支持及实施。这是具体套餐起价，不是通用 Acumatica 报价。应要求明确应用、容量、集成、实施和部署条款；本文未取得报价，归一月费保持未知。

sections.title_en: SaaS and private cloud allocate responsibility differently
sections.title_zh: SaaS 与私有云分配不同责任
sections.en:
The SaaS FAQ describes vendor provisioning, backups, monitoring and automated updates. It separately identifies a Private Cloud Subscription option and says partners explain deployment choices. A SaaS subscriber should plan for the Always Current upgrade program; additional timing flexibility is described through Acumatica Flex.

The FAQ says a SaaS sandbox is for testing and its changes are lost on refresh, rather than a direct path to push all changes into production. Evaluate customizations and connectors through the planned upgrade/test process. Neither private hosting nor a SaaS security statement independently establishes regulatory compliance or the right to redistribute source code.
sections.zh:
SaaS FAQ 介绍厂商负责环境开通、备份、监控和自动更新，也另列 Private Cloud Subscription，并由合作伙伴解释部署选择。SaaS 用户应规划 Always Current 升级安排；额外升级时间灵活性通过 Acumatica Flex 介绍。

FAQ 说明 SaaS 沙箱用于测试，刷新会丢失改动，不能把它视为直接向生产推送所有变更的路径。定制和连接器应通过计划的升级测试流程评估。私有托管或 SaaS 安全文案均不能独立证明监管合规或源码再分发权。

sections.title_en: Automatic backup does not guarantee an individual rollback
sections.title_zh: 自动备份不保证每次单客户回滚
sections.en:
The FAQ distinguishes automated backups from customer database snapshots and optional paid backup access. It says an individual restore may involve a service fee and that disaster-recovery backups may not suit a customer-specific rollback. Snapshots consume storage, and restoring one replaces current state.

The same FAQ describes a limited window after subscription expiration for requesting data. Confirm current contract/export and recovery arrangements before relying on any retention statement. In a safe evaluation, request a sample export and a restore demonstration in a separate environment. No production state or snapshot was changed during this research, and backup reliability was not tested.
sections.zh:
FAQ 区分自动备份、客户数据库快照和可付费购买的备份访问。页面说明单客户恢复可能产生服务费，灾难恢复备份未必适合客户级回滚；快照占用存储，恢复会替换当前状态。

同一 FAQ 还介绍订阅到期后请求数据有时间窗口。依赖保留说明前，应核对当前合同、导出及恢复安排。可在安全评估中要求样例导出，并在独立环境演示恢复。本研究未修改生产状态或快照，也未测试备份可靠性。

sections.title_en: Evaluate one complete process and its exceptions
sections.en:
Acumatica is worth investigating when finance, purchasing and fulfillment need one traceable process and the organization can own an ERP implementation. The selected application/edition and partner implementation determine practical fit. Claims of rankings, customer savings and effortless operation were not independently adopted.

Prepare masters, opening balances, warehouse/unit rules, permissions and approval owners. Then test insufficient stock, a duplicate external order, a supplier short receipt and a failed integration retry, inspecting both business records and ledger effects. These are proposed acceptance checks, not documented guarantees about every failure path. UI localization, regional filings, connector behavior and production performance remain unverified.
sections.zh:
当财务、采购和履约需要一条可追踪流程，且组织能负责 ERP 实施时，可以评估 Acumatica。实际适用性取决于选中的应用版本和伙伴实施。本文没有独立采用排名、客户节省或毫不费力运营等主张。

应准备基础资料、期初余额、仓库单位规则、权限及审批责任人，再测试缺货、外部订单重复、供应商短收和集成失败重试，并同时检查业务记录和总账影响。这些是建议验收，不是所有失败路径的文档保证；界面本地化、地区申报、连接器行为和生产性能仍未核实。

research_gaps.en: Contracted applications, resource limits, edition, migration/integration cost and current backup/export arrangements require a scoped quote.
research_gaps.zh: 合同应用、资源限制、版本、迁移集成费用及当前备份导出安排需要范围明确的报价。

research_gaps.en: No implementation, order, connector, upgrade, snapshot, restore, performance or statutory compliance was tested.
research_gaps.zh: 未测试实施、订单、连接器、升级、快照、恢复、性能或法定合规。
